missionQuestion: Select and freeze a stratified real-provision certification set (debt, liens, RP, investments, asset sales, financial covenants; with/without shared caps / builders / reclassification) from sealed CONMED/Chewy fixtures, then certify offline-pinned targets under fail-closed gates — without reopening sealed A/B, without paid §7.5(j) re-run, without NS-4, and without inventing related-series IR A/C Headroom Answer = paths/capacity/conditions/provenance (parity with related-series interim-B product posture).

forbiddenNow: additive related-series IR option A or C
reopening semantic-accountability.v8 / enumerator handoff / quantitative authority A/B seal
rewriting historical live evidence under docs/phase-3-live-validation/7.2c-* or 7.5j-end-to-end-certification/ (paid live packets immutable)
mutating docs/phase-3-live-validation/7.5j-deterministic-remediation/ (or any prior remediation/replay packet) in place after later remediations — future evidence must be new versioned packets

strata.notes: Includes baskets, ratio-based permissions, refinancing permissions. §7.2(c) already live-exhausted historically — remaining debt picks must be distinct sectionRefs.
Prefer quantitative baskets and exceptions with clear section anchors.
Baskets and ratio-based permissions; outbound-investment external-regime clauses stay residual if IR cannot encode them.
§7.5(j) already live-exhausted and carries interim-B series + non-vocab residuals — not first target; later strata rows may include non-series asset-sale baskets only if eligibility clears.
Ratio tests; eligibility must fail-closed if Phase-2 REVIEW_REQUIRED leverage definitions govern or enter the bundle unresolved.

crossCuts.evidenceHint: CONMED map SHARED_CAPACITY on §7.6(b) family; Phase 4C shared-capacity model is downstream of certified IR, not a substitute for Phase-3 cert

crossCuts.bindingRule: Include only when a sealed discovery candidate's operative text / map node exhibits builder/grower structure; mark TBD with blocker if no sealed CONMED/Chewy candidate is yet bound by sectionRef+discoveryId
CONMED §7.2 closing classification/anti-duplication mechanic is section-wide; bind a concrete discovery candidate before live — do not invent IDs

sealedPreferred.bindingRule: Chewy sectionRefs enter the frozen matrix only after the same offline identity+eligibility pin shape as first-target/; no invented discoveryIds

deterministicPickAlgorithm.description: Within each stratum, candidates are drawn from the sealed CONMED discovery population (and Chewy only after equivalent seal/pin). Sort by (packageKey, documentId, normalizedSourceRef, discoveryId). Exclude EXCLUSIONS. Prefer role in {BASKET, FINANCIAL_TEST, RATIO_BASED_PERMISSION, SHARED_CAP, QUANTITATIVE_PERMISSION}. First live pin prefers a family NOT already live-exhausted as §7.2(c)/§7.5(j).
deterministicPickAlgorithm.firstTargetOverride: Explicitly pinned in first-target/ before any live run; later matrix rows fill remaining strata/cross-cuts under the same algorithm without swapping the first pin.

firstTargetPin.why: RESTRICTED_PAYMENTS basket on sealed CONMED; not live-exhausted (unlike §7.2(c) debt / §7.5(j) asset sales); modest 191-char operative window; single occurrence; offline eligibility PASS with no governing Phase-2 REVIEW_REQUIRED provision; no related-series claim in operative text.

relatedSeriesInterimB.inScopeBehavior: Series-aggregation claims must disposition UNSUPPORTED (never REPRESENTED via lineage). Fail-closed in Ask Headroom. Not a certification PASS path until Architect ADR chooses A or C. Detector from PR #63 is temporary CONMED-shaped (\bseries\s+of\s+related\b) fail-closed only — not general related-series semantics solved.
relatedSeriesInterimB.outOfScopeThisPacket: Additive IR A/C; re-litigating Product PASS on interim B

detectorScope.note: PR #63 interim-B detector is fail-closed for CONMED-shaped phrasing only; near-miss / general related-series semantics remain unsolved until A/C ADR.

supportReviewRequired.inScopeBehavior: supportReviewRequired / SEMANTIC_SUPPORT_REVIEW_REQUIRED remains a certification REVIEW blocker until independently resolved; diagnostic asymmetry is not rewritten as CREDIT
supportReviewRequired.policyAlign: docs/evaluation-contract-v3/04-certification-vs-diagnostic-policy.json — creditEligibility + surfacingStatus are safety-critical; representationCompleteness/verificationStatus stay diagnostic until promoted

nonVocabularyUnsupported.inScopeBehavior: When Pass B emits a non-vocabulary inventoryDisposition, Pass C must map it to UNSUPPORTED with an explicit model-contract violation diagnostic — not ordinary quiet UNSUPPORTED. Preserve the raw non-vocab label and emit a distinct reason/code (e.g. UNSUPPORTED_VIA_NON_VOCABULARY_DISPOSITION / model-contract violation). Pass C → UNSUPPORTED alone is necessary but not the full diagnostic story. Honest residual, not silent MISSING.
nonVocabularyUnsupported.diagnosticRequirement: Explicit model-contract violation diagnostic required: raw inventoryDisposition label preserved + distinct reason/code (UNSUPPORTED_VIA_NON_VOCABULARY_DISPOSITION). Must not describe OOV→UNSUPPORTED as ordinary quiet UNSUPPORTED.

costCeiling.stopRule: If projected incremental spend for the remaining unpinned matrix would exceed packageSoftCeilingUsd, STOP and report before any further live dispatch. Cost is recorded; it does not weaken safety-critical certification dimensions.
costCeiling.note: Matches prior single-candidate live ceilings ($0.25). No paid calls authorized by this design packet.

First live candidate (when later authorized) is the pinned first-target/ — no silent swap
Certification decision uses production certifyCandidate blockers; CERTIFIED only when blockers empty; REVIEW_REQUIRED is honest fail-closed, not PASS
Related-series claims under interim B never receive REPRESENTED / CERTIFIED credit
Diagnostic dimensions do not override safety-critical creditEligibility / surfacingStatus (EC-V3 §8)
Zero provider calls in design validation / offline pin path
A/B seal semantic-accountability.v8 untouched; no NS-4 files in the change set

New stratified-cert evidence packets (and future remediation/replay evidence) are append/versioned; never mutate-in-place prior packets. softGate already forbids rewriting 7.2c/7.5j-end-to-end; do not mutate 7.5j-deterministic-remediation/ (or prior remediation packets) in place after later remediations — paid live 7.2c/7.5j-end-to-end stays immutable.
acceptanceCriteria.certifiedMeans: Candidate status CERTIFIED under phase3-candidate-certification.v1 with STRONG source identities, no REVIEW/BLOCKING blockers, and no interim-B series false credit. Package-level PARTIAL_TARGET_SET is expected until the full stratified set is complete — not a defect by itself.
acceptanceCriteria.liveAuthorizationLater: Live/paid runs require a separate authorization after Architect+Product+COO PASS on this packet. Historical §7.5(j) evidence is immutable; no re-pay.

Weakening EC-V3 safety-critical dimensions to raise automation rate
